notes: Which content is open when, keyed by stable game ids. House rule, pending owner confirmation: Forever launches 'before Molten Core', the original Classic Phase 1 content set, so any source that opened after Phase 1 in original Classic is gated until a date is announced, and a source whose original phase is unsure is gated and flagged 'uncertain'. Each gate has a phase key from phases.json, or 'later' with date 'unannounced'. A phase at or before 'launch' is open, so a confirmed date flips a gate by editing its phase and date here, with no code change. Keys: npcs (a vendor's or a dungeon boss's npc id; a world source by the npc's name, because loot.json's world sources carry no npc id), quests (quest id), factions (reputation faction id, gating its rep sources and every quest that needs it, from from_standing up when set), zones (an instance or zone source's zone id), kinds (a loot source kind), reagents (a crafting reagent no source names: every craft that consumes it is gated, by data/pipeline/loot/sources.py's apply_crafted_opens_gate, from classic-db's and the client's recipe chains) and, as a last resort, items. An id missing from a night's fetch is warned about and kept, never deleted. data/pipeline/loot/content_phases.py writes the gates into loot.json; sim/cmd/leveling-bis reads this same file and applies the same gates to whatever loot.json it is given.

gates.label: Era world bosses
gates.why: Raid-sized open-world bosses. Moved here from overlay.py's WORLD_BOSS_NPC_NAMES and data.go's worldBossSources, which pinned them to the first raid tier; Blizzard has dated no world boss.

gates.label: Ahn'Qiraj War Effort, Cenarion Circle and Brood of Nozdormu
gates.why: Gates of Ahn'Qiraj content. Anachronos sells the war-effort Signet Rings; Cenarion Circle and Brood of Nozdormu reputation is earned through the war effort and the raid. Replaces sources.py's REP_FACTION_RAID_PHASE_OPENS and data.go's raidLockedQuestOpens and repFactionRaidPhaseOpens, and restores the Anachronos gate commit 3592e40a5 deleted.

gates.label: Silithus: the Abyssal Council and Cenarion Hold
gates.why: The Silithus Twilight's Hammer lead-in to Ahn'Qiraj. The Council is summoned with Twilight set pieces and signets by a raid-sized group; Cenarion Hold's Armaments of War and hive quests came with the same patch. Silithus' own zone drops are gated with it because the Abyssal Lords' rings are also listed there.

gates.label: Dragons of Nightmare lead-in
gates.why: Twilight Corrupter, the Duskwood Nightmare boss summoned for the 1.8 dragon questline.

gates.label: Zul'Gurub and the Zandalar Tribe
gates.why: Zandalar Tribe reputation and the Yeh'kinya and Zul'Gurub turn-ins exist only to lead into or reward Zul'Gurub, which has no date. The Bloodsoul and Darksoul smithing need Souldarite (19774), a Zul'Gurub-only drop with no source in loot.json, so those crafted items are keyed directly.

gates.label: Scourge Invasion
gates.why: The Naxxramas lead-in event. Its six summoned dungeon bosses get their own gated source inside each dungeon instead of inheriting the dungeon's open status. Bone Witch, Lumbering Horror and Spirit of the Damned are its open-world elites, the only drop of Bracers and Wristwraps of Undead Slaying.

gates.label: Argent Dawn epic and superior armaments
gates.why: Insignia and Valor turn-ins added for the Naxxramas lead-in. Argent Dawn reputation itself is open at launch and is not gated.

gates.label: Tier 0.5: the dungeon set 2 quests, vendors and summoned bosses
gates.why: Forever has said nothing about Tier 0.5. The 226xxx ids are Season of Discovery re-itemisations kept in the client. Gated under the house rule until a date is announced.

gates.label: Honor system rank rewards
gates.why: Blizzard's 'How PvP Progression in Forever Works' says Honor and Rank Points run from launch with rank rewards (coordinator ruling 2026-10-30: an announced date opens a gate). pvpRankCap still limits which ranks count at each band.

gates.label: Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin and Alterac Valley reputation and rewards
gates.why: Owner ruling, sim-accuracy round 9 (2026-11-02): battlegrounds and PvP ranks run from launch (Blizzard's 'How PvP Progression in Forever Works', 7 October, ranks battleground honor across every original map, Alterac Valley included). The gate stays so every battleground quartermaster and the Alterac Valley summons and quests keep one named key; repStandingObtainable still holds revered and exalted to level 60.

gates.label: Darkspear Islands battleground rewards
gates.why: Owner ruling, sim-accuracy round 9 (2026-11-02): Forever's new 15v15 battleground, levels 30 to 60, is a launch battleground (Blizzard's 'Battle for the Darkspear Islands', 7 October, and 'Forever goes live globally 4 November'). Creeg Bothunk sells its reputation rewards.

gates.label: Powderfuse reputation rewards
gates.why: Round 9: the client's reputation sources (the items lane's client_rep) give Powderfuse's level-40 rewards a source. Powderfuse (Faction 2827, under the Steamwheedle Cartel) is the goblin port on the Riverglades' east coast (warcraft.wiki.gg, Powderfuse Port, patch 1.60.1), and Blizzard's 'Forever goes live globally 4 November' names the Riverglades among the launch destinations. Inferred: no Blizzard post names the faction.

gates.label: The Watchers reputation rewards
gates.why: Not launch content on the evidence (owner ruling, round 10). The client's reputation sources give The Watchers' sixteen level-60 signets (Friendly to Exalted, 275968 to 275984) and Nelanna's Enchanted Jewel (277519, Honored) a source. Faction 2819 (70707) is the night elves' jailers, who 'stand vigilant to ensure that no threat can ever escape their extensive underground network of prisons'. Blizzard's raid overview (news.blizzard.com article 24303009) makes the Barrow Deeps that prison, a level-60 10-player raid with entrances from Mount Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold, and asks 'how the wardens plan to contain the danger below'; it unlocks on 9 December with Hyjal Summit and Onyxia. The 70707 client ties the wardens to it: Brooch of the Wardens (277136) 'grants access to the Vord'anaar Prison within Barrow Deeps', and map 2817 is Starfall Barrow Den. No Blizzard post, client quest or reputation row, or Wowhead Forever page (faction 2819 and the signets, fetched 2026-11-02) names a launch zone, a quartermaster or a way to earn the reputation before then. So it stays gated; revisit when the Barrow Deeps opens or Blizzard names how the reputation is earned.

gates.label: Darkmoon Faire decks, ticket prizes and vendor
gates.why: No statement on a Faire schedule in Forever.

gates.label: Dire Maul
gates.why: Opened after Molten Core in original Classic. Forever has not announced it. The zone gate cannot see a quest handed in outside the instance, so these quests are listed by id: the Libram quests that pay the Royal Seals of Eldre'Thalas, the Felvine Shards, the Shen'dralar treasure and the forging of Quel'Serrar all need items from inside Dire Maul.

gates.label: Season of Discovery-era reputation vendor stock
gates.why: These vendors' Wowhead Forever rows list only 2278xx Season of Discovery items, with no cost and no standing. Wowhead may have inherited them; the beta was capped at level 30, so nobody has seen them in Forever.

gates.label: Pix Xizzix's Tarnished Undermine Real stock
gates.why: Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay sells this stock for Tarnished Undermine Reals (currency 3469, client cap 165; belts 100, rings and cloaks 75, trinkets 125, per the beta vendor records on zockify.com and questing.wiki, 2026-10-09). Blizzard's 17 September Q&A brings the Reals back as 'kind of like that emblem of justice system', a reason to re-run dungeons, and dungeons are open at launch. Inferred: no Blizzard post names the vendor or the drop sources, and nobody had reached 60 on live when this was set.

gates.label: Forever's new Undermine traders
gates.why: Wowhead labels this stock 'New in Forever'. Its currency and launch timing are unknown, so it is gated until confirmed.

gates.label: Reagents from Hyjal Summit and Barrow Deeps loot
gates.why: Feedback 2026-11-09: the level-60 Protection Paladin list picked Greenhammer (279261) and Evergreen Shield (279262), Forever's new Blacksmithing epics. Their recipes, and every other Forever-new craft that uses it (client SpellReagents), need Malleable Essence of Nature, which the 1.60.1.70790 client describes as 'Acquired from disenchanting items from Hyjal Summit or Barrow Deeps'. Blizzard's raid overview (news.blizzard.com article 24303009) opens both raids on 9 December. The essence has no loot source, so it is keyed here and the crafted gate (pipeline.loot.sources.apply_crafted_opens_gate) carries its date to each craft.

gates.label: Obsidian crafted gear
gates.why: Every Obsidian recipe needs Small or Large Obsidian Shards (22202, 22203), which drop only in Ahn'Qiraj. Neither shard has a source in loot.json, so the recipe-and-reagent gate cannot see it; the crafted items are keyed directly.

gates.label: Recipes from the 1.9 to 1.11 range
gates.why: Flagged by the audit by id range only; their recipes are not verified. Item ids are the last-resort key here because the recipe sources are not in loot.json.
